fact: BusinessDay reports the federal government is preparing a blended-funding programme in which the USPF finances towers and backhaul, the REA solar power and states land, for zero-connectivity communities, with about 3,700 towers planned to start in October and 200 by December 2026.

The Punch reports Hotspot Network Limited secured a World Bank-backed results-based facility under the DARES programme with the Rural Electrification Agency to deploy 2G/4G, broadband and community Wi-Fi in 500 unserved and underserved communities.
